title: LRUCache evicts entries that were just read
statement:
We memoise balance lookups with ledgerlite.lru.LRUCache and the hottest keys keep getting evicted and recomputed under load.

Repro:

    from ledgerlite.lru import LRUCache
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    c.get('a')        # 'a' was just used
    c.put('c', 3)
    'a' in c          # False -- expected True; 'b' was the least recently used

The class docstring says a successful get() counts as a use of the key, just like put(). keys(), hit/miss counters and eviction order should all follow that rule. Please fix the library; keep the public API unchanged.
